fact: Writing after the WAPIS centre was inaugurated at Force Headquarters, Abuja, on 26 May 2021, the Ministry of Police Affairs' press unit states that divisional police stations lack basic ICT infrastructure, that writing a statement, generating a report and entering biodata in police stations are done manually, and that most criminal records are not made electronically; WAPIS is funded by the European Union and implemented by INTERPOL, with a first batch of 20 workstations across police, immigration, NAPTIP and NDLEA sites.
title: Enhancing effective POLICING with infrastructural support…as WAPIS DATABASE CENTRE debuts
publisher: Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation
